translated_text:
REGENT OF NORTH CENTRAL TIMOR

HAS DECIDED:

To Enact: REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S EMPOWERMENT.

heading: CHAPTER I
text:
BAB I

KETENTUAN UMUM

Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Pemerintah Kabupaten Timor  Tengah utara.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Timor Tengah Utara.
4. Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat  DPRD adalah Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah Kabupaten  Timor Tengah Utara.
5. Sekretaris daerah adalah Sekretaris Daerah Kabupaten Timor  Tengah Utara.
6. Dinas adalah Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  urusan pemerintahan dibidang pemberdayaan perempuan dan  Perlindungan Anak.
7. Kepala dinas adalah Kepala Perangkat Daerah yang  menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan.
8. Perangkat Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat PD adalah  Perangkat Daerah di Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara. 9. Kepala Perangkat Daerah adalah Kepala Perangkat Daerah di  Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara.
10. Badan adalah Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  urusan Pemerintahan di bidang perencanaan pembangunan  dan penelitian daerah.
11. Kepala Badan adalah Perangkat Daerah yang  menyelenggarakan urusan Pemerintahan di bidang  perencanaan.
12. Pemberdayaan Perempuan adalah setiap upaya meningkatkan  kemampuan fisik, mental spiritual, sosial, pengetahuan, dan  keterampilan agar perempuan siap didayagunakan sesuai  dengan kemampuan masing-masing.
13. Pengarusutamaan Gender, yang selanjutnya disingkat PUG  adalah strategi yang dibangun untuk mengintegrasikan gender  menjadi satu dimensi integral dari perencanaan, pelaksanaan,  pemantauan dan evaluasi atas kebijakan dan program  pembangunan daerah.
14. Gender adalah konsep yang mengacu pada peran-peran dan  tanggung jawab laki-laki dan perempuan yang terjadi akibat  bentukan masyarakat dan dapat berubah oleh keadaan sosial dan budaya masyarakat.
15. Kesetaraan Gender adalah kesamaan kondisi bagi laki-laki dan  perempuan untuk memperoleh kesempatan dan hak-haknya  sebagai manusia agar mampu berperan dan berpartisipasi  dalam proses pembangunan.
16. Keadilan Gender adalah suatu proses untuk menjadi adil  terhadap laki- laki dan perempuan.
17. Kelompok Kerja Pengarusutamaan Gender, yang selanjutnya  disebut Pokja PUG adalah wadah konsultasi bagi pelaksana  dan penggerak pengarusutamaan gender dari berbagai  instansi/lembaga di daerah.
18. Focal Point Pengarusutamaan Gender, yang selanjutnya disebut  Focal Point PUG adalah aparatur PD yang mempunyai  kemampuan untuk melakukan pengarusutamaan gender di unit kerjanya masing-masing.
19. Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Daerah, yang  selanjutnya disingkat RPJMD adalah penjabaran dari visi, misi  dan program Bupati yang penyusunannya berpedoman pada  Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Panjang Daerah, yang memuat  strategi pembangunan daerah, kebijakan umum daerah, 3 program daerah dan kerangka ekonomi makro yang mencakup  gambaran perekonomian secara menyeluruh termasuk arah  kebijakan fiskal dalam rencana kerja yang berupa kerangka  regulasi dan kerangka pendanaan yang bersifat indikatif.
20. Analisis Gender adalah proses yang dibangun secara sistematik  untuk mengidentifikasi dan memahami pembagian kerja atau  peran laki-laki dan perempuan, akses dan kontrol terhadap  sumber-sumber daya pembangunan, partisipasi dalam  pembangunan dan manfaat yang mereka nikmati.
21. Anggaran Responsif Gender adalah alokasi anggaran yang  berbasis kinerja pada program atau kegiatan tertentu yang  indikator input (masukan), output (keluaran), dan outcome  (hasil) dapat menjamin terpenuhinya aspirasi dan kebutuhan  perempuan dan laki-laki secara adil.
22. Komunikasi, Informasi dan Edukasi yang selanjutnya disingkat  KIE adalah penyampaian pesan berupa keterangan, gagasan  maupun kenyataan berkaitan dengan pengarusutamaan  gender yang perlu diketahui masyarakat secara langsung atau  tidak langsung melalui saluran komunikasi kepada penerima  pesan untuk mendapatkan efek, sebagai proses perubahan perilaku  ke arah responsif gender.
23. Musyawarah Perencanaan Pembangunan Kelurahan/desa yang  selanjutnya disebut Musrembangkel adalah forum musyawarah  perencanaan pembangunan tahunan kelurahan/desa yang  melibatkan para pelaku pembangunan di Kelurahanldesa.
24. Musyawarah Perencanaan Pembangunan Kecamatan yang  selanjutnya disebut Musrembangcam adalah forum  musyawarah antar para pelaku pembangunan untuk  membahas dan menyepakati langkah-langkah penanganan  program kegiatan prioritas yang tercantum dalam daftar  usulan perencanaan kegiatan pembangunan kelurahan yang  diintegrasikan dengan priotiras pembangunan daerah  Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara di wilayah kecamatan yang  dikoordinasikan oleh Badan Perencanaan Pembangunan Daerah dan dilaksanakan oleh Camat.
25. Musyawarah perencanaan pembangunan untuk penyusunan  Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Daerah yang  selanjutnya disebut Musrembang RPJMD adalah forum  musyawarah antara pemangku kepentingan untuk membahas,  mempertajam dan menyepakati rancangan Rencana  Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Daerah.
26. Rencana Strategis yang selanjutnya disebut Renstra adalah  dokumen perencanaan lima tahunan yang memuat visi, misi,  tujuan, strategi, kebijakan, program dan kegiatan  pembangunan sesuai dengan tugas dan fungsi organisasi  sebagai penjabaran dari RPJMD.
27. Rencana Kerja yang selanjutnya disebut Renja adalah dokuman  perencanaan satu tahunan yang memuat kebijakan, program,  dan kegiatan pembangunan baik yang direncanakan langsung  oleh Perangkat Daerah maupun ditempuh dengan mendorong  partisipasi masyarakat sebagai penjabaran dari Renstra.
28. Rencana Kerja Pemerintah Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat  RKPD adalah dokuman perencanaan satu tahunan yang memuat  kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan pembangunan baik yang  direncanakan langsung oleh Pemerintah Daerah maupun ditempuh dengan mendorong partisipasi masyarakat sebagai  penjabaran dari Renstra.
29. Rencana Aksi Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat RAD adalah dokumen  perencanaan kegiatan yang disusun oleh tim teknis yang akan  dilaksanakan pada periode /waktu tertentu.
30. Gender Analisys Pathway yang selanjutnya disingkat GAP adalah suatu  alat analisis gender yang dapat digunakan untuk membantu para  perencana dalam melakukan pengarusutamaan gender dalam  perencanaan kebijakan / program / kegiatan pembangunan dengan  tujuan agar dapat mengidentifikasi kesenjangan gender (gender gap) dan permasalahan gender (gender issues) serta sekaligus menyusun  rencana kebijakan/program/kegiatan pembangunan yang ditujukan  untuk memperkecil atau menghapus kesenjangan gender tersebut.
31. Tim Teknis adalah Tim yang dibentuk oleh pokja PUG dengan tugas  melakukan analisis anggaran yang berprespektif gender dan menyusun  RAD PUG.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:

1. Region is North Central Timor Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of North Central Timor Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of North Central Timor.
4. Regional House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is the Regional House of Representatives of North Central Timor Regency.
5. Regional Secretary is the Regional Secretary of North Central Timor Regency.
6. Office/Department is a Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and Child Protection.
7. Head of Office/Department is the Head of Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment.
8. Regional Apparatus, hereinafter abbreviated as PD, is the Regional Apparatus in North Central Timor Regency.
9. Head of Regional Apparatus is the Head of Regional Apparatus in North Central Timor Regency.
10. Board is a Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of development planning and regional research.
11. Head of Board is a Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of planning.
12. Women's Empowerment is every effort to improve physical, mental spiritual, social, knowledge, and skills capacity so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
13. Gender Mainstreaming, hereinafter abbreviated as PUG, is a strategy built to integrate gender into an integral dimension of planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of regional development policies and programs.
14. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of social construction and can change due to social and cultural circumstances of society.
15. Gender Equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so that they are able to play a role and participate in the development process.
16. Gender Justice is a process to be fair to men and women.
17. Gender Mainstreaming Working Group, hereinafter referred to as Pokja PUG, is a consultation forum for implementers and movers of gender mainstreaming from various agencies/institutions in the region.
18. Gender Mainstreaming Focal Point, hereinafter referred to as Focal Point PUG, is a PD apparatus that has the ability to carry out gender mainstreaming in their respective work units.
19. Regional Medium-Term Development Plan, hereinafter abbreviated as RPJMD, is the elaboration of the vision, mission and program of the Regent whose preparation is guided by the Regional Long-Term Development Plan, which contains regional development strategies, general regional policies, 3 regional programs and macroeconomic framework that includes an overview of the economy as a whole including the direction of fiscal policy in a work plan in the form of a regulatory framework and funding framework that is indicative.
20. Gender Analysis is a process built systematically to identify and understand the division of labor or roles of men and women, access and control over development resources, participation in development and the benefits they enjoy.
21. Gender Responsive Budget is a performance-based budget allocation for certain programs or activities whose input, output, and outcome indicators can ensure the fulfillment of the aspirations and needs of women and men fairly.
22. Communication, Information and Education, hereinafter abbreviated as KIE, is the delivery of messages in the form of information, ideas or facts related to gender mainstreaming that need to be known by the community directly or indirectly through communication channels to message recipients to obtain effects, as a process of behavioral change towards gender responsiveness.
23. Village/Sub-district Development Planning Deliberation, hereinafter referred to as Musrembangkel, is an annual village/sub-district development planning deliberation forum that involves development actors in the Village/Sub-district.
24. District Development Planning Deliberation, hereinafter referred to as Musrembangcam, is a deliberation forum among development actors to discuss and agree on steps to handle priority program activities listed in the list of proposed village development planning activities that are integrated with development priorities of North Central Timor Regency in the district area coordinated by the Regional Development Planning Board and implemented by the District Head.
25. Development planning deliberation for the preparation of the Regional Medium-Term Development Plan, hereinafter referred to as Musrembang RPJMD, is a deliberation forum among stakeholders to discuss, sharpen and agree on the draft Regional Medium-Term Development Plan.
26. Strategic Plan, hereinafter referred to as Renstra, is a five-year planning document that contains the vision, mission, objectives, strategies, policies, programs and development activities in accordance with the organizational tasks and functions as an elaboration of the RPJMD.
27. Work Plan, hereinafter referred to as Renja, is a one-year planning document that contains policies, programs, and development activities both planned directly by Regional Apparatus or pursued by encouraging community participation as an elaboration of the Renstra.
28. Regional Government Work Plan, hereinafter abbreviated as RKPD, is a one-year planning document that contains policies, programs, and development activities both planned directly by the Regional Government or pursued by encouraging community participation as an elaboration of the Renstra.
29. Regional Action Plan, hereinafter abbreviated as RAD, is an activity planning document prepared by a technical team to be implemented in a certain period/time.
30. Gender Analysis Pathway, hereinafter abbreviated as GAP, is a gender analysis tool that can be used to assist planners in mainstreaming gender in planning development policies/programs/activities with the aim of identifying gender gaps and gender issues as well as simultaneously preparing development policy/program/activity plans aimed at reducing or eliminating such gender gaps.
31. Technical Team is a Team formed by Pokja PUG with the task of conducting gender-perspective budget analysis and preparing RAD PUG.

heading: CHAPTER II
text:
BAB II

RUANG LINGKUP

Pasal 2

Ruang lingkup penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan  meliputi:
a. kualitas hidup perempuan;
b. perlindungan perempuan;
c. kualitas keluarga; dand. sistem data gender.
translated_text:
CHAPTER II

SCOPE

Article 2

The scope of Women's Empowerment administration includes:
a. quality of life of women;
b. protection of women;
c. quality of family; dand. gender data system.

Bagian Kesatu

Umum
translated_text:
CHAPTER III

QUALITY OF LIFE OF WOMEN

Part One

General

heading: Article 3
text:
Pasal 3

Kualitas Hidup Perempuan meliputi:
a. pelembagaan PUG ;
b. Pemberdayaan Perempuan bidang politik, hukum, sosial dan  ekonomi pada organisasi kemasyarakatan; danc. penguatan dan pengembangan Lembaga penyedia layanan  pemberdayaan perempuan.
translated_text:
Article 3

Quality of Life of Women includes:
a. institutionalization of PUG;
b. Women's Empowerment in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations; danc. strengthening and development of women's empowerment service provider institutions.

heading: Article 5
text:
Pasal 5

1. Bupati berwenang menetapkan Kepala PD yang menyelenggarakan  urusan pemerintahan di bidang Pemberdayaan Perempuan  sebagai koordinator penyelenggaraan PUG.
2. Penetapan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dengan Keputusan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 5

1. The Regent is authorized to appoint the Head of PD that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment as the coordinator of PUG administration.
2. The appointment as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be by Regent's Decree.

heading: Paragraph 3

Paragraph 3

Pokja PUG

heading: Article 6
translated_text:
Article 6

1. The Regent has the authority to establish the PUG Working Group.
2. The establishment of the PUG Working Group as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Regent's Decree.
3. The Regent's Decree as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be valid for 5 (five) years.
4. The management of the PUG Working Group consists of:
a. chairperson by the head of the agency;
b. secretariat by the head of the office;
c. members including:
1. head of PD;
2. technical team consisting of:
a. apparatus who have attended training or education in gender-responsive budget analysis of at most 5 (five) persons.
b. representatives of university elements of at most 5 (five) persons;
c. press representatives of at most 5 (five) persons; and
d. representatives of non-governmental organizations that have an orientation scope in the field of gender of at most 5 (five) persons.

heading: Article 7
Paragraph 4
text:
Paragraf 4

Focal Point PUG
translated_text:
Paragraph 4

PUG Focal Point

heading: Article 8
translated_text:
Article 8

1. The Regional Secretary has the authority to establish a PUG Focal Point within the Regional Secretariat.
2. The establishment of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Regional Secretary's Decree.
3. The management of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. person in charge by the regional secretary;
b. coordinator by an echelon IIB official in charge of governmental affairs in the field of law;
c. vice coordinator by an echelon IIIA official of each division in the regional secretariat except for the echelon IIB official as referred to in letter b; and
d. members by representatives of officials and/or staff from all divisions in the regional secretariat.

heading: Article 9
translated_text:
Article 9

1. The Head of PD is obliged to establish a PD PUG Focal Point.
2. The establishment of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be by Head of PD's Decree.
3. The management of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. person in charge by the head of PD;
b. coordinator by an echelon III A official in charge of planning affairs at the PD;
c. Vice Coordinator by an Echelon IIIB Official who has competence in PUG; and
d. Members by representatives of Officials or staff from divisions and secretariat at the PD.

heading: Article 10
translated_text:
Article 10

1. The Hospital Director has the authority to establish a Hospital PUG Focal Point.
2. The establishment of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Hospital Director's decree.
3. The management of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. person in charge by the hospital director;
b. coordinator by an echelon IIIB official in charge of hospital planning;
c. vice coordinator by an echelon IVA official who has competence in PUG; and
d. members by representatives of officials or staff in divisions or sections within the hospital.

heading: Article 11
text:
Pasal 11

1. Kepala Pusat Kesehatan Masyarakat berwenang membentuk  Focal Point PUG Puskesmas.
2. Pembentukan Focal Point PUG sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat  (1) ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Kepala Pusat Kesehatan Masyarakat.
3. Kepengurusan Focal Point PUG puskesmas terdiri atas:8a. penanggungjawab oleh Kepala Puskesmas;
b. koordinator oleh pejabat eselon IV B yang membidangi  perencanaan Puskesmas; danc. anggota terdiri dari staf Puskesmas.
translated_text:
Article 11

1. The Head of the Community Health Center has the authority to establish a Puskesmas PUG Focal Point.
2. The establishment of the PUG Focal Point as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by Head of Community Health Center's Decree.
3. The management of the puskesmas PUG Focal Point consists of:
a. person in charge by the Head of Puskesmas;
b. coordinator by an echelon IV B official in charge of Puskesmas planning; and
c. members consisting of Puskesmas staff.

Paragraph 6

Budgeting

heading: Article 16
text:
Pasal 16

1. Pemerintah Daerah wajib mengalokasikan anggaran bagi  pelaksanaan PUG di Daerah.
2. Anggaran pelaksanaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  bersumber dari:

a.APBD; dan

b.bantuan dari pihak lain yang tidak mengikat, sepanjang sesuai  dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

3. Anggaran sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2),  digunakan untuk membiayai kegiatan Pokja PUG dan Focal Point PUG PD dalam mengintegrasikan Gender di tingkat  perencanaan, penyusunan, pelaksanaan, pemantauan dan  evaluasi kebijakan dan pembangunan di Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 16

1. Regional Governments are obliged to allocate budget for the implementation of PUG in the Region.
2. The implementation budget as referred to in paragraph (1) is sourced from:

a. APBD; and

b. assistance from other parties that is not binding, as long as it is in accordance with the provisions of the applicable laws and regulations.

3. The budget as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2), is used to finance the activities of Pokja PUG and Focal Point PUG PD in integrating Gender at the level of planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of policies and development in the Region.

heading: Paragraph 7
text:
Paragraf 7

Pemantauan dan Evaluasi
translated_text:
Paragraph 7

Monitoring and Evaluation

heading: Article 17
text:
Pasal 17

1. Bupati berwenang melakukan pemantauan dan evaluasi  terhadap pelaksanaan PUG.
2. Bupati dapat melimpahkan pelaksanaan pemantauan dan  evaluasi kepada Pokja PUG.
3. Pemantauan dan evaluasi dilakukan pada tiap PD dan/atau  lembaga lainnya yang melaksanakan upaya PUG.
4. Pemantauan dan evaluasi dilaksanakan paling sedikit setiap 6  (enam) bulan sekali.
translated_text:
Article 17

1. The Regent is authorized to conduct monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of PUG.
2. The Regent may delegate the implementation of monitoring and evaluation to Pokja PUG.
3. Monitoring and evaluation is conducted at each PD and/or other institutions that carry out PUG efforts.
4. Monitoring and evaluation is implemented at least every 6 (six) months.

heading: Article 18
text:
Pasal 18

Pemantauan pelaksanaan PUG dilakukan melalui:
a. pemantauan penyusunan dokumen perencanaan pembangunan responsive gender baik di tingkat PD maupun di tingkat daerah; b. pemantauan RAD PUG; danc. verifikasi Laporan pelaksanaan RAD PUG.
translated_text:
Article 18

Monitoring of PUG implementation is conducted through:
a. monitoring the preparation of gender responsive development planning documents both at the PD level and at the regional level;
b. monitoring RAD PUG; and
c. verification of RAD PUG implementation Reports.

heading: Article 19
text:
Pasal 19

Evaluasi pelaksanaan PUG dilakukan melalui:
a. evaluasi capaian dan tantangan pelaksanaan RAD PUG; b. penyusunan RAD PUG periode berikutnya;
c. evaluasi capaian dan tantangan pelaksanaan PUG tiap 6 (enam) bulan; dand. penyusunan rencana pelaksanaan PUG 6 (enam) bulan  berikutnya.

heading: Paragraph 8
text:
Paragraf 8

Pelaporan PUG
translated_text:
Paragraph 8

PUG Reporting

heading: Article 20
text:
Pasal 20

1. Pokja PUG bertanggung jawab menyusun Laporan Pelaksanaan  PUG setiap 6 (enam) bulan dan Laporan Pelaksanaan RAD PUG  lima tahunan.
2. Kerangka pelaporan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  berpedoman pada kerangka pelaporan sebagaimana dimaksud  dalam peraturan perundang-undangan tentang Pedoman Umum  Pelaksanaan PUG di Daerah.
3. Laporan Pokja PUG sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dilaporkan kepada Bupati.
4. Bupati bertanggung jawab memeriksa dan menyatakan  persetujuan Laporan Pokja PUG sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1).
5. Bupati bertanggung jawab dalam pengiriman laporan pokja PUG  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) kepada Menteri yang  menyelenggarakan urusan Pemerintahan Dalam Negeri.
translated_text:
Article 20

1. Pokja PUG is responsible for preparing PUG Implementation Reports every 6 (six) months and five-yearly RAD PUG Implementation Reports.
2. The reporting framework as referred to in paragraph (1) is guided by the reporting framework as referred to in the laws and regulations concerning General Guidelines for PUG Implementation in the Region.
3. Pokja PUG Reports as referred to in paragraph (1) are reported to the Regent.
4. The Regent is responsible for examining and stating approval of Pokja PUG Reports as referred to in paragraph (1).
5. The Regent is responsible for sending pokja PUG reports as referred to in paragraph (1) to the Minister who administers Home Affairs governmental affairs.

heading: Paragraph 9
text:
Paragraf 9

Pengawasan
translated_text:
Paragraph 9

Supervision

heading: Article 21
text:
Pasal 21

1. Bupati bertanggungjawab melakukan pengawasan terhadap  pelaksanaan PUG.
2. Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dalam bentuk: a. perencanaan dan pengganggaran responsif Gender yang dilakukan oleh tim anggaran pemerintah daerah;
b. pelaksanaan koordinasi antara Pokja PUG dan Focal Point  gender; danc. perkembangan pencapaian RAD PUG setiap tahun. (3) Tanggung jawab sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) secara  teknis operasional dapat dilaksanakan oleh Ketua Pokja PUG  dan Kepala Sekretariat Pokja PUG.
4. Pelaksanaan tanggung jawab sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat  (3) dilaporkan kepada Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 21

1. The Regent is responsible for conducting supervision of the implementation of PUG.
2. Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is in the form of:
a. Gender responsive planning and budgeting conducted by the regional government budget team;
b. implementation of coordination between Pokja PUG and Focal Point gender; and
c. progress in achieving RAD PUG every year.
3. The responsibility as referred to in paragraph (1) may be technically and operationally implemented by the Chairperson of Pokja PUG and the Head of the Pokja PUG Secretariat.
4. The implementation of responsibility as referred to in paragraph (3) is reported to the Regent.

heading: Part Three
text:
Bagian Ketiga

Pemberdayaan Perempuan Bidang Politik, Hukum, Sosial  Budaya Dan Ekonomi Pada Organisasi Kemasyarakatan
translated_text:
Part Three

Paragraph 1

General

heading: Article 22
text:
Pasal 22

Upaya Pemberdayaan Perempuan bidang politik, hukum, sosial  budaya dan ekonomi pada organisasi kemasyarakatan meliputi  tahapan:
a. perencanaan;
b. pelaksanaan; danc. pelaporan dan evaluasi.
translated_text:
Article 22

Women's Empowerment efforts in the political, legal, socio-cultural and economic fields in community organizations include stages:
a. planning;
b. implementation; and
c. reporting and evaluation.

heading: Paragraph 2
text:
Paragraf 2

Perencanaan
translated_text:
Paragraph 2

Planning

heading: Article 23
text:
Pasal 23

1. Badan bertanggungjawab dalam memfasilitasi perencanaan  Pemberdayaan Perempuan bidang politik, hukum, sosial budaya  dan ekonomi pada organisasi kemasyarakatan.
2. Perencanaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan  secara terintegrasi dalam musyawarah perencanaan  pembangunan berdasarkan instrumen gender analysis pathway.
translated_text:
Article 23

1. The Agency is responsible for facilitating the planning of Women's Empowerment in the political, legal, socio-cultural and economic fields in community organizations.
2. Planning as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted in an integrated manner in development planning deliberations based on gender analysis pathway instruments.

heading: Paragraph 3
text:
Paragraf 3

Pelaksanaan
translated_text:
Paragraph 3

Implementation

heading: Article 24
text:
Pasal 24

Pelaksanaan Pemberdayaan Perempuan pada organisasi  kemasyarakatan dilaksanakan oleh PD sesuai dengan tugas  pokok dan fungsi yang diemban sesuai dengan kemampuan  keuangan daerah.
translated_text:
Article 24

The implementation of Women's Empowerment in community organizations is carried out by PD in accordance with the main tasks and functions carried out in accordance with regional financial capacity.

heading: Article 25
text:
Pasal 25

1. PD yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  kesatuan bangsa dan politik bertanggungjawab dalam  memfasilitasi pemberdayaan perempuan di bidang politik.
2. Pemberdayaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: a. melaksanakan pendidikan dan pelatihan bagi perempuan  dalam rangka peningkatan kompetensi khususnya dibidang  politik; danb. mendorong adanya keterwakilan perempuan dalam setiap  kepengurusan organisasi kemasyarakatan.
translated_text:
Article 25

1. PD that administers governmental affairs in the field of national unity and politics is responsible for facilitating women's empowerment in the political field.
2. Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. implementing education and training for women in order to increase competence especially in the political field; and
b. encouraging the representation of women in every management of community organizations.

heading: Article 26
text:
Pasal 26

1. PD yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  hukum bertanggungjawab dalam memfasilitasi Pemberdayaan  Perempuan di bidang hukum.
2. Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang hukum meliputi:a. peningkatan kesadaran dan pengetahuan di bidang hukum  melalui layanan komunikasi informasi dan edukasi; dan b. fasilitasi akses dan layanan konsultasi hukum.
translated_text:
Article 26

1. PD that administers governmental affairs in the legal field is responsible for facilitating Women's Empowerment in the legal field.
2. The implementation of Women's Empowerment in the legal field includes:
a. increasing awareness and knowledge in the legal field through communication, information and education services; and
b. facilitation of access and legal consultation services.

heading: Article 27
translated_text:
Article 27

1. PD that administers governmental affairs in the social field is responsible for facilitating Women's Empowerment in the socio-cultural field.
2. Women's Empowerment in the socio-cultural field through:
a. increasing knowledge, attitudes and skills to encourage the fulfillment of tiered education in accordance with potential to improve social status;
b. increasing awareness, willingness and ability to overcome health problems through quality promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative efforts especially in the field of reproductive health;
c. increasing awareness and knowledge about independent, healthy and prosperous family planning including access to consultation services and marriage registration; and
d. facilitation and efforts to preserve customs and the development of science, technology, arts and culture for the advancement of women.

heading: Article 28
Paragraph 4
text:
Paragraf 4

Pelaporan dan Evaluasi
translated_text:
Paragraph 4

Reporting and Evaluation

heading: Article 29
text:
Pasal 29

1. Setiap PD bertanggungjawab membuat laporan pelaksanaan  kegiatan Pemberdayaan Perempuan yang telah dilaksanakan  kepada Bupati melalui Dinas.
2. Dinas setelah menerima laporan yang disampaikan oleh PD  melakukan evaluasi terhadap pelaksanaan kegiatan. (3) Hasil evaluasi pelaksanaan kegiatan sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (2) dilaporkan kepada Bupati.
4. Hasil evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) digunakan  untuk perencanaan penganggaran tahun berikutnya.
translated_text:
Article 29

1. Each PD is responsible for making reports on the implementation of Women's Empowerment activities that have been carried out to the Regent through the Dinas.
2. The Dinas after receiving the report submitted by the PD conducts an evaluation of the implementation of activities.
3. The results of the evaluation of the implementation of activities as referred to in paragraph (2) are reported to the Regent.
4. The evaluation results as referred to in paragraph (3) are used for budgeting planning for the following year.

heading: Article 33

1. Bupati melakukan pemantauan pelaksanaan kebijakan,  program, dan kegiatan perlindungan perempuan.
2. Pemantauan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dimaksudkan untuk mengetahui perkembangan dan hambatan  dalam pelaksanaan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan  Perlindungan perempuan di Daerah.

translated_text:
Article 33

1. The Regent conducts monitoring of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women.
2. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is intended to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of women in the Region.
3. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (2) is conducted periodically on PD through the Office.
4. Monitoring is conducted from planning to implementation of policies, programs and activities for the Protection of women for the current year.

heading: Article 34
text:
Pasal 34

1. Evaluasi pelaksanaan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan  Perlindungan Perempuan dilakukan setiap berakhirnya tahun anggaran.
2. Hasil evaluasi pelaksanaan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan  Perlindungan perempuan digunakan sebagai bahan masukan  bagi penyusunan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan  Perlindungan Perempuan untuk tahun berikutnya.
3. Evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan  sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 34

1. Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women is conducted at the end of each fiscal year.
2. The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of women are used as input for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women for the following year.
3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: CONCERNING
text:
TENTANG

PENYELENGGARAAN PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN

I. UMUM

Hadirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang  Pemerintahan Daerah sebagaimana telah diubah beberapa kali,  terakhir dengan Undang-Undang Nomor 9 Tahun 2015 tentang  Perubahan Kedua Atas Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintah Daerah dan Undang-Undang Nomor 33  Tahun 2004 tentang Perimbangan Keuangan Antara  Pemerintah Pusat dan Pemerintahan Daerah merupakan pintu  masuk bagi Pemberdayaan Perempuan dalam pembangunan  daerah. Pemberdayaan perempuan merupakan strategi  pembangunan yang tepat untuk mewujudkan kesetaraan dan  keadilan gender melalui kebijakan dan program pembangunan  yang sensitif dan responsif gender di masa yang akan datang,  khususnya di Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara.

Di Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara terdapat beberapa kondisi yang perlu diintervensi dengan pembentukan Peraturan  Daerah tentang Pemberdayaan Perempuan. Hal ini terjadi  karena ada banyak diskriminasi terhadap kaum perempuan  dalam mengembangkan diri dan kesempatan untuk  pemenuhan hak mereka. Perempuan hanya dianggap sebagai  kaum kelas dua. Tugasnya adalah mengurus rumah tangga  dan tidak perlu bekerja. Hal ini yang perlu dilawan, stigma ini  menjadi sebuah masalah yang harus diselesaikan dengan  program pemberdayaan.

Paradigma diatas tercermin dalam data keberadaan  perempuan yang bekerja di Pemerintahan, data menunjukan  bahwa perempuan tidak berada pada posisi stategis untuk  turut mengambil keputusan ataupun kebijakan terutama  dalam urusan Pemerintahan melalui data ASN berdasarkan  jenis kelamin yang tersedia di lapangan.

Berdasarkan pemikiran tersebut, sudah saatnya di  Kabupaten Timor Tengah Utara membentuk Peraturan Daerah  tentang Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Kabupaten Timor Tengah  Utara. Peraturan Daerah inilah yang akan mengatur  pelaksanaan pengarusutamaan gender secara jelas, tegas,  seimbang dan komprehensif untuk mewujudkan kesetaraan dan keadilan gender serta sekaligus memberikan pemahaman  tentang pentingnya pemberdayaan perempuan sebagai sebuah  strategi analisis gender dalam perencanaan, penyusunan,  pelaksanaan, pemantauan dan evaluasi kebijakan dan program pembangunan.
translated_text:
CONCERNING

THE IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S EMPOWERMENT

I. GENERAL

The presence of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as has been amended several times, most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015 concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government and Law Number 33 of 2004 concerning Financial Balance Between the Central Government and Regional Governments constitutes an entry point for Women's Empowerment in regional development. Women's empowerment is an appropriate development strategy to realize gender equality and justice through gender-sensitive and gender-responsive development policies and programs in the future, particularly in North Central Timor Regency.

In North Central Timor Regency there are several conditions that need to be intervened with the establishment of a Regional Regulation concerning Women's Empowerment. This occurs because there is much discrimination against women in developing themselves and opportunities for the fulfillment of their rights. Women are only considered as second-class citizens. Their duty is to take care of the household and they do not need to work. This is what needs to be fought against, this stigma becomes a problem that must be resolved with empowerment programs.

The above paradigm is reflected in data on the presence of women working in Government, data shows that women are not in strategic positions to participate in making decisions or policies, especially in Government affairs through data on civil servants based on gender available in the field.

Based on this thinking, it is time for North Central Timor Regency to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Women's Empowerment in North Central Timor Regency. This Regional Regulation will regulate the implementation of gender mainstreaming clearly, firmly, in a balanced and comprehensive manner to realize gender equality and justice as well as simultaneously provide understanding about the importance of women's empowerment as a gender analysis strategy in planning, formulating, implementing, monitoring and evaluating development policies and programs.
